acceptance_contract: REJECT if anything that was not in the supplied picture appears in it, or if a smudge, a repeated texture patch or a colour seam is visible where something was changed.
ACCEPT only if the viewpoint visibly travels around the bottle (a different side of the bottle is seen at the end than at the start).
ACCEPT only if the bottle keeps the shape, size, cap and blank label of the first frame throughout; REJECT if it warps, drifts on the surface, or grows lettering.
REJECT if the highlight on the glass flickers, or sits at the same spot on the bottle in the first and last frame while the viewpoint has changed.
REJECT if speech or music is present, or any lettering.

case_values.CA-D1: 1st read stays the bottle; no new cue is introduced by the move.
case_values.CA-D10: 6 s: 'the camera slowly circles a cold glass bottle' (gote_0053).
case_values.CA-D11: Motivated move: the customer asked for the orbit; slow, a quarter-turn at most, so the technique goes unnoticed (ms_0018).
case_values.CA-D3: The orbit must keep the deliberate gap above the cap in every frame (fre_0006).
case_values.CA-D7: One continuous shot; device: camera move.
case_values.PA-D1: As the still: glass direct, liquid translucent, cap polished, ground matte — finishes must persist through the orbit.
case_values.PA-D10: No deviation; the accepted still is the creative decision.
case_values.PA-D2: The single highlight must travel across the glass as the viewpoint changes (a direct reflection moves with the family of angles, scs_lsm_c003_002); it must not stay painted on.
case_values.PA-D4: The still's window source camera-left is preserved; the orbit is small enough that the source stays on one side.

generation_prompts.main: Animate this product still, 6 seconds, silent. The camera moves slowly in a small arc around the bottle, about a quarter turn, keeping the bottle the same size in frame with a small gap above the cap. Nothing else moves. No text or lettering.
